applicabilityBasis.summary: Falcon Digital Limited's USDf Terms permit USDf-funded card payments and redemption for originally deposited digital collateral or other stablecoins. GENIUS section 2(22) separately requires an issuer obligation to redeem for fixed monetary value and defines exclusions. Under owner ruling D17, crypto collateral, U.S. access restrictions and the separate fUSD product do not establish a USDf exemption. Applicability remains unclear pending qualified token-specific holder-contract analysis; authorization research is separate.

genius.notes: The prior 2026-06-07 editorial non-payment-token classification is withdrawn on 2026-10-01 under D17 pending qualified USDf-specific legal analysis. Current Terms expressly support USDf card payments, while direct redemption returns digital collateral or other stablecoins; neither fact alone resolves the statutory monetary-value obligation. U.S. access restrictions and the distinct Anchorage-issued fUSD product do not establish a USDf exclusion or authorization. Historical reserve-report observations are retained: the quarterly HT Digital report covers 2026-04-30 and is signed 2026-06-19; weekly collateral letters do not establish monthly formal assurance.
